## Born of the Oni

In Wano the oni are a legend told to frighten children. Some legends have horns.

Be of the Oni race.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- Be of the Oni race

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +2 Training Points (your race)

## Drunken Dragon

Kaido fights better drunk, and drinks often. An oni gets stronger after the third cup.

Reach the highest state of drunkenness and defeat something with your bare fists while drunk.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Wano Country](r_oni.md#q-564091a24ee81500)

**Tasks**

- Reach the highest state of drunkenness
- Win a fight with bare fists while drunk

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +24,500, +4 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-21d4c5109c1833c1"></a>

## Onigashima

Kaido built his fortress inside a skull-shaped mountain off the coast of Wano.

Defeat forty enemies in Wano and reach 37,500 Doriki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Drunken Dragon](r_oni.md#q-55937cfb6c1c6866)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 40 enemies in Wano
- Reach 37,500 Doriki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +6 Training Points (your race)

<a id="q-7ad3d8fb54cc2f75"></a>

## Emperor of the Beasts

Kaido tried to die forty times and failed every time. He took Wano instead.

Keep drinking at the highest state of drunkenness and hold Wano through island conquest.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Onigashima](r_oni.md#q-21d4c5109c1833c1)

**Tasks**

- Keep drinking at the highest state of drunkenness
- Own Wano Country (island conquest)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +150,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +8 Training Points (your race)
